mechanism.notes: minarc variant A (spherical 3R + passive sensed spring knuckle K in link 1, physical q2 stop at J2) with the J3 stack order swapped: link 2 pressed on hub 3's face (lower member), member 3 (cap plate + K7 neck) on the cap (upper member) bridging over link 2. Same parts, same count as variant A. bodies: link 1a, link 1b, link 2, member 3. joints: J1, K, J2, J3 O20 hubs on MR117-2RS pairs. custom: base, 3 links, member 3, 4 hub shafts, the clock spring; catalogue: 4 MR117-2RS pairs + 2 O2 stop dowels.

verdict: SCREENED, not a contender as a 3-active design: the inverted J3 stack is a real but conditional lever on the knuckle chain (+4.8 frozen exact points at C5's seats, +1.95 at D2's, -0.7 at variant A's LA1), and searched together with the J3 seat it lifts variant A from 41.14 to 28.46 frozen exact (score 89.65; fast plain 22.87 / near-touch 26.26) at complexity 13.5 - but it buys band with the overhead (overhead reach 0.18, overhead clip follow 0.6 frozen / 0.4 fast, min metal 0.0 mm, near-touch 35.44), K is sensed (4 active under the counting rule), and 28.46 does not beat H1 (27.20 on this protocol) or minarc BDp (19.06).
limiter: Hub-3 OBLIQUITY on the arm and the overhead acromion, not the stack order: a J3 axis through GH meets the arm skin 30-39 deg off its normal at the seats where the knuckle reaches (wd 46-70), so the 20 mm O20 disc spans 12-16 mm of height (hub 3 0.49-0.69 in band); seats at the deltoid crest (wd >= 75-90, obliquity 16 deg, hub 3 0.82) lose reach (0.70 median vs 0.77) and overhead poses push hub 3 / hub 2 up (C6 hub 3 F 81 set by elevation 165). Reach loss at C6 (fast, 160 ws): 22 fold (th 17 folded / 129-147 stretched, K's own span b1 + b2 - 5 = 69.2), 10 contact; overhead 0 of 12 ws, 2 of 17 named.
